description: Generate the Behavioral-Gate GitHub Actions setup — the self-hosted-runner prerequisites, the workflow YAML (using the edgegate-bg composite action), and the gh secret commands. Unlike the standard run gate, BG runs the model on a real device, so it needs a self-hosted runner with the device attached.

adb_serial.description: adb serial of the attached device.

name: edgegate_setup_bg_github_action
